items.title: NYS Bottle Drive
items.description: NYS hosted a bottle drive on Sunday, March 30, 2025, from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM to support the Peace Arch Hospital Foundation. Participants donated empty bottles and cans by leaving them at the curb or dropping them off at a Return-It Express site.

items.title: NYS Annual Conference
items.description: On December 18, 2024, NYS celebrated its 2024 achievements with its Annual Conference, starting with a $2,000 donation to the Peace Arch Hospital Foundation for its production kitchen project. President Solenn Sun highlighted the year's accomplishments, while the Foundation recognized volunteers with certificates.

items.title: NYS Christmas Jazz Concert at Peace Arch Senior Village
items.description: NYS hosted its annual Christmas Jazz Concert at Peace Portal Senior Village, bringing holiday cheer to senior residents. Featuring talented musicians performing holiday classics and jazz standards, the event created a lively, festive atmosphere.

items.title: Charity Flea Market Supporting Peace Arch Hospital Foundation
items.description: NYS and EcoStyle hosted a Charity Flea Market at the South Surrey Community Centre, raising over $1,000 for the Peace Arch Foundation. With 20+ vendors, live music, and nearly 500 attendees, the event promoted sustainable living.

items.title: UBC Youth Business Competition
items.description: On August 17, Amy and James, two NYS members helped volunteer for the event.

items.title: Peace Arch Hospital 70th Birthday Celebration
items.description: NYS volunteers joined the Peace Arch Hospital 70th Birthday Celebration. They had a DIY tie-dye stand to help raise funds for the 10 million goal for Medical Imaging at Peace Arch Hospital!

items.title: DIY Tie-Dye Fundraiser
items.description: NYS Volunteers hosted a DIY Tie-Dye fundraiser to benefit Peace Arch Hospital Foundation at Crescent Beach.

items.title: TEDx Grandview Heights Volunteers
items.description: NYS Volunteers worked at TEDx-Grandview Heights at Surrey Arts Centre.

items.title: Volunteering for a urban planning workshop
items.description: NYS provided volunteer service to an urban planning workshop at Semiahmoo Library. Our volunteers are busy preparing hand-made candles, home-grown vegetables and bakery for our Green Home Gift Pack Sale at the event!

items.title: Richmond Hospital Donut Fundraiser
items.description: In April 2022, NYS organized a donut fundraiser for Richmond Hospital Foundation. 12 volunteers, 180 donuts sold within the two days, 200 dollars profits for donation, and numerous commendations...

items.title: Christmas Cards For Seniors 2021
items.description: On the Christmas Eve of 2021, we delivered 110 Christmas cards to senior activity centres and retirement homes across Vancouver. Click the button for more information on the event.

items.title: West Vancouver Branch Established
items.description: In 2019, we started another Noble Youth Society branch in West Vancouver. Check out moments from our opening ceremony!

items.title: Foodie Club Season II
items.description: In 2018, we held our second Foodie Club event, "Golden spoon". Click to see the photo gallery for this event.

items.description: In 2017, we held our first Foodie Club event "little chef". Check out for more!
